plan.notes: Plan intro states 79-80 major-specific credits and a 120-credit university minimum; the published term layout sums to 80 credits as encoded (EE Upper Division Requirement slots listed as 3-4 credits are encoded at the 3-credit lower bound per the range rule). GE is selected by the student around the published major courses, so only the major courses appear in this plan. MATH 110 (3 cr) OR MATH 115 (4 cr) in Y1 Fall; MATH 111 (3 cr) OR MATH 116 (4 cr) in Y1 Spring; first options encoded with choice_notes. MATH 210 carries the plan footnote '* Not required for those who took MATH 116'; encoded as a choice slot. EENG 398 (Topics in Advanced Engineering Applications, 1 credit) is genuinely repeated in three semesters with varying topics per the official plan; allow_repeated_courses is set. 6 'Electrical Engineering Upper Division Requirement' and 3 'Electrical Engineering Elective' slots are genuine named requirement slots; student selects specific courses with advisor. Per-slot prereqs are not published on the 4-year plan page; prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Source: official Chapman University 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog, '' (Suggested 4-Year Plan). https://catalog.chapman.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=46&poid=9853 The catalog states a minimum of None credits to graduate and None major-specific credits for this degree; the plan page publishes major courses by term only — General Education/minor courses are selected by the student around this plan, so total_credits (80) is the sum of the published major-course slots, not the 120-credit degree minimum. Per-slot prerequisites are not published on the 4-year plan page, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. Variable-credit courses are encoded at the source lower bound with the range documented in choice_note.
